name: Pine Crossing
description: A quiet crossroads settlement nestled among the pines.

rumors: Wolves have grown bold on the northern roads. Travel in numbers.
A merchant caravan went missing near the Thornwood. Bandits, most like.
They say the old Stone Ruins are cursed. No one who enters comes out the same.

quests.npc_desc: A hooded bounty hunter nursing a drink alone.
